purpose: Civilian component reference specifications for a synthetic observation demo; no procurement decision, tested assembly or validated drone detector.

conditions.snr: A-weighted, PDM clock 3.072 MHz; datasheet common conditions VDD 1.8 V, 25 C, audio bandwidth 20 Hz to 20 kHz.
conditions.sensitivity: 1 kHz, 94 dB SPL; specified tolerance +/-1 dB.
conditions.acoustic_overload_point: THD = 10%; microphone overload is not a detection range.

profiles.integration_status: Reference components only. PDM capture/bridge, drivers, electrical compatibility, enclosure and end-to-end audio path have not been selected or tested. Not a wiring or assembly specification.
profiles.simulation_use: Metadata only; no acoustic model or score is inferred from microphone SNR or board CPU.

profiles.interaction: Explicit user-submitted sighting or sound report, represented by an anonymous synthetic source. Not automatic background phone sensing.
profiles.simulation_use: Presence report with null classifier confidence. No identities, real phone locations or recordings.

profiles.interaction: Dedicated fixed smartphone on a fictional pilot pole; separate from voluntary citizen reports. Synthetic acoustic candidate and device-health metadata only.

deployment_assumptions.power: External supply with illustrative battery fallback
deployment_assumptions.network: Unspecified IP uplink; synthetic online/offline telemetry
deployment_assumptions.enclosure: Weather enclosure shown for visualization; no IP rating or thermal qualification claimed

profiles.integration_status: Phone, microphone, application, enclosure, power and network hardware have not been selected or tested. No installation or wiring specification. Offline status is a synthetic gateway report, not a message transmitted by a disconnected handset.
profiles.simulation_use: Two fixed installations with delayed receipt, loss and recovery. No real microphone access, audio recording or automatic association with radar tracks.

simulation_contract.freshness_basis: Demo assumption, not hardware update-rate or real detection performance.
simulation_contract.classifier_score: Synthetic optional value in [0,1], not attack probability, calibrated confidence or datasheet performance.
simulation_contract.reporting_zone_radius: Fictional map annotation; not sensor range or measured positional accuracy.
simulation_contract.clock: observed_at_ms and available_at_ms are offsets from shared replay start, preserving observation vs receipt time.
simulation_contract.radar_association: unknown; community reports are not automatically linked to existing tracks.
simulation_contract.device_health: Latest received synthetic gateway/device report, with observation and receipt times; stale metadata is not live health.

design_input.status: internal proposal; not a validated performance specification
